Meta.title: Wasl
Meta.description: Continuity for dialogues between askers and dāʿīs.

Home.tagline: Talk with a person about Islam, and pick up where you left off.
Home.trustPersonTitle: A real person, not a bot
Home.trustPersonBody: Every reply comes from a dāʿī.
Home.trustAnonBody: Just a pseudonym. No email, no phone number.
Home.trustControlBody: Nothing from your conversation is shared without your approval.

Enter.pseudonymHint: Any name you like. You'll use it to come back.
Enter.backgroundQuestion: Anything you'd like the dāʿī to know about you?
Enter.backgroundHint: Optional. Share only what you choose.
Enter.codeBody: Copy it or write it down. It's the only way back to this conversation from another device, and it won't be shown again.
Enter.haveCode: Been here before? Return with your code

Return.title: Welcome back
Return.hint: Enter your pseudonym and return code.

Login.title: Staff sign in

team.name: Name

team.emailTaken: That email is already in use.
team.invalid: Check the fields: at least one language, capacity 1 to 20.

settings.thresholdHint: Alert when an asker waits longer than this.
settings.aiExplain: When off, everything runs on the full manual path: askers write their question themselves, routing uses the simple rules, and dāʿīs write cards by hand. Nothing stops working.
settings.invalid: Check the fields: a name, at least one language, 1 to 240 minutes.
